question: India's first struggle for independence started on 10th May 1857 at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meerut**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's first struggle for independence, also known as the Revolt of 1857, started on 10th May 1857 at **Meerut**.
 
• This revolt was a major, but ultimately unsuccessful, uprising against the British East India Company's rule in India.
 
• The revolt began with the mutiny of sepoys of the Company's army in the town of **Meerut**.
 
• It soon escalated into other mutinies and civilian rebellions, primarily in the upper Gangetic plain and central India.
 
• The Revolt of 1857 is also referred to as the First War of Indian Independence, the Sepoy Mutiny, and the Indian Mutiny.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The revolt was characterized by the discontent of the Indian soldiers in the British army, caused by various factors including the use of animal fat in rifle cartridges, which was against their religious beliefs.
 
• The revolt led to significant changes in the British administration and their policies in India.
 
• Post-revolt, the British Crown took direct control of India from the East India Company, leading to the establishment of the British Raj.
 
• The uprising had profound impacts on Indian society and was a precursor to the later movements for independence.
 
• The Revolt of 1857 remains a significant event in the history of India, symbolizing the country's resistance against colonial rule.
